name: @bmfk/api
description: TypeScript framework for HTTP API services: validated endpoints, signed microservice calls, a 2FA operations console and a deployer with blue-green releases
author: Igor Bloom

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp ./src/apiServer/monitor/index.html ./dist/apiServer/monitor/index.html && cp ./src/apiServer/documentation/index.html ./dist/apiServer/documentation/index.html && cp ./src/apiServer/review/index.html ./dist/apiServer/review/index.html && chmod +x ./dist/apiServer/deployment/cli.js
scripts.test: rm -rf build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage build-test/test/*.test.js
